title: Choose a real domain for the protocol namespace
description: The spec uses https://corundum.example/ns/v1 (JSON-LD context, WebFinger rel) — corundum.example is reserved (RFC 6761) and cannot ship. Mark must pick a domain the project controls; then replace everywhere. NEEDS MARK.
notes: Chapter 45 vectors embed https://corundum.example/ns/v1 in the activity bytes: regenerate with tools/gen-test-vectors.py after the namespace changes.
